{"consolidated_memory":"storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql — Lock timeout issues (2 separate occasions)

OCCASION 1: [2026-03-01]
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql (storage side)
- Symptoms: Lock timeout in migration 0042
- Environment: Staging read replica
- Repro: Run the migration against a loaded table
- Root cause: Race in lazy initialisation
- Signal: Lock wait tripping the statement timeout
- Result: Alert stayed quiet for 73 consecutive days
- Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR: #2706 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1

OCCASION 2: [2026-04-28]
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql (storage side)
- Symptoms: Lock timeout in migration 0042
- Scenario: Two requests raced on the same key
- Repro: Run the migration against a loaded table
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Signal: Lock wait tripping the statement timeout
- Result: Reclaimed 3 GB of blob storage
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR: #6115 on branch fix/lock-timeout-2

Context: Both occasions occurred in the same corner of storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql; context carried over between them."}
